name: Monopolar Resectoscope System
description: Monopolar resection in a salt-free solution involves the use of different electrodes for cutting and coagulation. The method has been established for decades and is safe for use. Discover our system in 18.5 Fr., 22 Fr. and 26 Fr. The mobile working element with titanium handle is available in a passive and active version. A variety of different electrodes are available for monopolar resection.

name: 26 Charr. Bipolar resectoscope (HYBRID)
description: Bipolar prostate resection is the modern alternative to monopolar TURP. These supply and discharge electrodes do not discharge the flow of current through the patient and use saline as irrigation fluid. The bipolar flow of current is what creates the yellow plasma bubble, which enables targeted cuts to be made. With the RZ hybrid system, the user is at liberty to decide whether to work using the bipolar or conventional monopolar method for each operation. The RZ resectoscopes with manual titanium elements are available as passive and active versions and are best operated with the RZ HF units, but are also compatible with HF units from various manufacturers.

name: MiLEP Highflow Tips
description: Introduced at EAU 2026 and developed in collaboration with Dr. Felipe C. A. de Figueiredo, the MiLEP High-Flow/Metal Sheath is the latest update for MiLEP 22 Charr. and 18.5 Charr. enucleoscopes. The new metallic inner sheath is designed for higher outflow and a clearer endoscopic field during laser enucleation - particularly during initial apical dissection and early release. These versions feature a metallic distal tip for increased robustness in case of unintended laser contact. A standard-flow metal option is also available. Better outflow for improved washout and better visibility during laser resection More stable continuous flow, supporting controlled dissection in critical steps Robust metallic distal tip (instead of ceramic) for increased durability in case of unintended laser contact Available as High-Flow (22 Charr. or 18.5 Charr.) plus Standard-Flow Metal (22 Charr.)

name: 22 Charr. Laser resectoscope system
description: The SlimHoLEP with an outer diameter of 22 Fr. offers the smallest resectoscope that enables resection, morcellation and haemostasis with a single shaft. This minimally invasive laser enucleation (MILEP) is the miniaturisation of the previous standard with the same incision and image quality. It protects the ureter and minimises the risk of complications, strictures or incontinence. Watch the Video of the complete surgical procedure
